Title: Parallel Artificial Membrane Permeability Assay (PAMPA) 7
Description: Parallel Artificial Membrane Permeability Assay (PAMPA) is an in vitro surrogate for the permeability of drugs across cellular membranes. PAMPA at pH 7.4 was experimentally determined by NIH-NCATS in a dataset of 5,473 unique compounds. Half the dataset was used to train an SVM classifier, validated on the remaining half with AUC = 0.88. Peff was log-transformed: log Peff below 2.0 was taken as low to moderate permeability and above 2.5 as high permeability, with intermediate compounds omitted. A subset of the data is available at PubChem (AID 1645871).
Interpretation: Probability of a compound being poorly permeable (logPeff < 1)
